description: First-person 'I'm doing this right now' screen recording with bold static caption boxes. Modelled on Riley Brown's high-view dev TikToks and the #vibecoding cluster. Distinct from raw_demo_build_log: this is the builder's POV, not the product flex.
recommended_use: First-person Rally-about-Rally posts. The voice is Chris (or a stand-in) discovering, building, or reacting in real time. Best for moment-of-progress moments: a successful render, a passing eval, an agent PR, the loop closing.
reference_notes: First-person voiceover only. Never narrate in third person — the script must say 'I' or 'we', not 'Rally is...'
Open with the result or the surprise in the first 1.5 seconds, then explain.
Static red-on-black or black-on-yellow caption boxes that hold for 2-4 seconds, not word-by-word.
End every video with one specific comment-CTA, e.g. 'comment merge if you'd build this'.
Real screen captures dominate. Generated visuals only as transitions or framing devices.
Reference library row 1 (rileybrown.ai 'I CONTROLLING BLENDER'), row 2 (4.7M views, talking head + curiosity gap), row 9 ('Vibe Coding With Claude Opus 4.6 Max').

camera: natural phone framing if camera footage is involved
composition_rules: First 1.5s shows the result, the surprise, or the bold claim.
Caption boxes occupy bottom 25% or upper 33%, never center.
Real UI is the primary canvas. Generated visuals only as transitions.
Keep cursor moving, scrolling, or interacting; static screens read as boring.
End frame must include the comment-CTA in caption form.

caption_treatment.style: static red-on-black box with bold white text, 2-4s holds

default_routes.hook: real screen recording of final result, or bold-text caption-card on real screenshot
default_routes.mid_demo_proof: real screen recording with annotation overlay
default_routes.surprise_or_reveal: real screen recording at moment of result
default_routes.comment_cta: static text card with rally yellow background and bold call-to-action
default_routes.b_roll: deterministic zoom/pan over real capture; never generative b-roll

fallback_routes.screen_capture_failed: operator-provided screenshot or proof card; never generated UI
fallback_routes.low_motion_clip: add deterministic cursor/highlight/zoom motion in assembly
